title: Activation-history condition encoded as resolution-history condition (four cards)
body:
Dragon Whelp, Nalathni Dragon, Farrelite Priest, and Initiates of the Ebon Hand count ability activations, but their encoding uses `TimesThisAbilityHasResolvedThisTurnIs(GreaterThanOrEqualTo(Integer(4)))`.

The condition must count activations, including abilities that are countered, rather than resolutions. All four cards have a threshold of four activations.
